messages:
Jules (CS): NexaHealth sent back the vendor risk form with two problematic asks — 1) they insist on 7-year log retention across the board, and 2) they want explicit per-customer deletion confirmation for 'derivative embeddings'. Renewal is due in 28 days. Need quick triage.
Ravi (AE): Do we know which logs? app logs vs access/audit?
Jules (CS): Their redline doesn't specify. Legal flagged 'all logs' language.
Eli (Security): 7 years is a no-go. We typically keep access logs 90d, audit trails 2y (can archive longer), and infosec logs per SOC2 config. For embeddings: need clarity — 'derivative embeddings' is vague. We can support deletion requests but operationally it's different depending on retention policy.
Marta (Onboarding): I can spin up a quick call tom 11am PST with Legal + Security + CS. @Ravi @Sam (Platform)
onboard-bot: Reminder: vendor-form response SLA is 72 hours for accounts in renewal pipeline.
Sam (Platform): We store embeddings as object blobs with tenant prefixes and lifecycle rules. We can run a purge job and emit a deletion receipt. Sample config snippet:
```yaml
embeddings:
  retention_days: 90
  deletion_ack: true
```
Ravi (AE): If we offer 90 days + deletion within 5 business days + deletion receipt, will that be acceptable in most cases?
Eli (Security): Yes, assuming Legal is okay with deletion attestation language. Also propose updating '7 years' to 'audit logs: 2 years; access logs: 90 days; statutory exceptions handled case-by-case.'
Jules (CS): I'll draft a redline: replace '7 years' with Eli's suggestion + propose embeddings compromise: 90d retention, deletion on request w/in 5 business days, provide deletion attestations. I'll drop the draft here for review before sending to their counsel.
Sam (Platform): I'll attach an example deletion attestation PDF and a sample manifest from the purge job (anonymized).
Ravi (AE): I'll review the redline and help with commercial framing — we can offer an addendum for customers with special retention needs (paid).
Eli (Security): +1. Once Sam's attestation attached I'll sign off.
Marta (Onboarding): Please tag Legal when you post the draft. I can coordinate the call and note action items.
Jules (CS): Thanks team. Target: send redline to NexaHealth legal by EOD today. Posting draft in 1 hour.
